node.title: Intrinsic pair/carrier ranks leave only ten- and eleven-dimensional survivors
node.statement: For EVERY original KoalaBear error-rank12 normalization J9965..21499 and valid assignment, define U as the sum of both component direction images of aff(P_2), s=dim U<=11 and r=affdim P_2<=2s. If s<=9, every pair rank is paid by238911770855075395 including near134944 once, without a pencil hypothesis. If s<=10,r<=17, the whole source is paid by274138707278280353, reserve842020833114734. The required r<=15 theorem holds for any s. Auxiliary pair/shared rank embeddings18/9 and17/10 permit nine and seven guarded anchors; the first ends at a point, the second at3/3 with both child types paid. The original V, rank, complete core, field, offsets and labels are not replaced. Every over-budget choice has exactly s=10,r18..20 or s=11,r16..22, hence pair-space codimension<=2 or<=6 respectively. No density, higher original-rank payment, full J value, unrestricted row, endpoint, active atom or Prize closure is claimed.
